signals.name: Airbnb tourist presence
signals.measures: Short-term rental supply and review velocity per H3 cell: active listings, reviews in the last 12 months, and growth vs the prior 12 months (counts only).
signals.source: Inside Airbnb, Paris listings + reviews summary files (open download).
signals.license: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 (Inside Airbnb data use terms).
signals.refresh: Monthly (when Inside Airbnb publishes a new Paris snapshot).
signals.caveat: Proxy for visitor/tourist footfall, not restaurant buzz. Only listing coordinates and review dates are stored, no host or review text.

signals.name: Landmark attention
signals.measures: Sum over landmarks within 600 m of cell center of log1p(90-day fr.wikipedia pageviews, human readers only) for OSM features tagged with a French Wikipedia article.
signals.source: OpenStreetMap landmarks + Wikimedia Pageviews API (fr.wikipedia, agent=user).
signals.license: ODbL (OSM); Wikimedia data under CC BY-SA 3.0 / API terms.
signals.refresh: Weekly pageviews pull; landmarks refreshed on build.
signals.caveat: Encyclopedia readership proxies cultural attention, not dining-specific social buzz. Pageviews use Wikimedia agent=user (human traffic); redirect titles resolve to canonical articles.

signals.name: Paris events footfall
signals.measures: City open-data events geocoded to cells: count in the last 12 months and count in the upcoming 90 days (coordinates + dates only).
signals.source: Paris Open Data, dataset que-faire-a-paris- (export API).
signals.caveat: Official events calendar; excludes informal or social-only gatherings. Rolling windows anchor on the Paris export file date, not the Inside Airbnb snapshot.

signals.name: Google Trends, cuisine
signals.measures: Weekly relative search interest by cuisine keyword for Île-de-France (official API gated; manual exports rejected by design).
signals.source: Google Trends (no compliant automated access in product).
signals.caveat: official API gated; manual exports rejected by design

signals.name: INSEE Sirene, food service establishments
signals.measures: Administrative creation and closure dates for Paris food-service establishments (format groups from NAF), geolocated to H3 cells, counts only, no names or SIRET.
signals.source: INSEE Base Sirene stock + géolocalisation établissements (data.gouv.fr).
signals.granularity: Establishment events aggregated to H3 cells
signals.caveat: Registry dates reflect administrative registration/closure, not trading days; NAF format groups are not cuisine; no revenue or engagement data. Personal data (sole traders) excluded, only salted establishment hashes stored.

signals.name: Foursquare place footprint
signals.measures: Venue place graph density (would require Foursquare Open Places).
signals.source: Foursquare Open Places (Hugging Face gated dataset).
signals.status: Not used: NO-GO (Paris coverage not verified)
signals.caveat: NO-GO per foursquare_go_nogo.md: Paris coverage not verified, gated Parquet unreadable without HF token; no local slice on disk. Do not wire into builds until manual drop and checklist re-run.

signals.name: Simulated social virality
signals.measures: Illustrative attention surface for committee walkthroughs (not measured).
signals.caveat: Clearly labeled Simulated; never mixed with Real or Proxy tiers.

signals.name: Instagram / TikTok (platform APIs)
signals.measures: Post volume, hashtags, and creator reach on major social platforms.
signals.source: Meta Content Library / TikTok Research API (academic access).
signals.status: needs academic access: Meta Content Library / TikTok Research API; not pursued, future work
signals.caveat: No paid APIs and no scraping policy, not pursued in this product phase.

real_social_access.summary: Instagram, TikTok, Google Maps, TheFork, and TripAdvisor are not ingested. The product uses no paid APIs and does not scrape social platforms.

paths.access: Meta Content Library, academic/research eligibility required.
TikTok Research API, restricted research access.
